room_rent.note: Room & boarding up to max 1% of SI per day; pro-rata if higher room opted

icu.note: ICU/ICCU up to max 2% of SI per day

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-payment on every admissible claim; waivable by paying additional premium (optional)

sub_limits.note: Room/ICU % caps; HIV/AIDS and disability covers have specific sub-limits per schedule

initial_waiting.note: 30 days indemnity; 90 days for benefit/lumpsum cover

specific_disease_waiting.note: Per Policy Schedule; not applicable for accidents

maternity.note: Maternity listed under Excl18 exclusion. VERIFY optional availability

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus benefit identified in wording. VERIFY

restoration.note: No SI restoration benefit identified in base wording. VERIFY

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalization expenses excluded per wording

ayush.note: AYUSH up to 100% of SI in AYUSH hospital

ambulance.note: Emergency ground ambulance up to ₹2,000 per hospitalization

grace_period.note: 30 days annual; 15 days for monthly instalments

notable_exclusions.display: Mandatory 20% co-pay; maternity & domiciliary excluded; SI capped at ₹4-5L; HIV/AIDS & disability on benefit basis
